item.summary: Marking its historic Foundation Day , the Central Bureau of Narcotics (CBN) celebrated its 77 th foundation Day on 6 th November 2026. On this occasion a programme was organised at CBN Headquarters Gwalior in which all the officers and staff participated.
item.title: Central Bureau of Narcotics (CBN) celebrates 77th Foundation Day and reaffirms India's vision for a “Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat”, through intensified enforcement, digital governance, and mission "Yuva Raksha"
